desc:
🤖 Kaiju Battles 🦖

Giant monsters are tearing the city apart, and you’re the only one with a 50-foot robot.

Jump into your mech and fight wave after wave of kaiju. You control each arm yourself, so every punch is one you actually throw.

🥊 FIGHT HOW YOU WANT
• Swing hooks and uppercuts with your mech’s arms
• Grab a kaiju and throw it into another one
• Charge a super jump and slam down on the ground with both fists
• Wreck buildings as you go

🎲 ROLL FOR MECHS
Roll for new mechs, from Common to Mythic. Each one has its own speed, power, armor and special ability. Feeling lucky? Try a Lucky Roll.

👥 SQUAD UP
Queue up with friends, choose a difficulty, and see how many waves you can survive together.

The city needs a pilot. Get in the mech. 🔥
